The '''''Nal Hutta Jewel''''' was a [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstrel''-class space yacht]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. It was the base of operations for [[Ganis]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="HL" />
